source_policy: Complete generic source and native receiving; private cases, credential values, host custody routes and private runtime receipts are excluded. The committed APPLICATION_SOURCE.json is a prepared member lock with explicit base-revision provenance. Generate the final native source lock from the actual immutable publication commit.

source_edition.meaning: Prepared member lock: source_commit identifies the inspected base; exact member identities describe this additive edition. Regenerate with build_application.py lock --revision ACTUAL_FULL_COMMIT for a final-revision native package.
